findings.claim: One commenter says they experience this problem: Freelance designers waste time collecting scattered client feedback on design drafts.

quotes.text: Draft is a Design Feedback tool for Freelance Designers & Small Teams that helps you clear and organise your feedback.

findings.reason: The quote describes Draft's purpose as a tool to help freelance designers organize feedback, which addresses the problem of scattered client feedback but doesn't explicitly confirm that users experience this problem.
findings.limitations: The quote doesn't specify if users actually experience scattered feedback or if Draft solves it.

findings.claim: One commenter says they experience this problem: Freelance designers waste time collecting scattered client feedback on design drafts.

quotes.text: After years as a freelance graphic designer, I noticed that most of my clients couldn't distinguish a good design from a better one!

findings.reason: The quote describes a specific experience of the speaker as a freelance designer, but the claim states a general problem experienced by 'one commenter'. The context shows the speaker's personal experience, not a representative sample.
findings.limitations: Limited to one person's experience, not generalizable to all freelance designers.
